```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source("_common.R") # nolint: undesirable_function_linter.

global_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "global_stats.csv"))
min_obs <- read_min_obs("csv")
percentage <- read_percentage("csv")
global_rrmse_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path("csv", "global_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)
```

## Degraded variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(global_rrmse_comparison)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  n_not_tested <- status_summary(global_rrmse_comparison, min_obs)
  if (n_not_tested > 0) {
    writeLines(c(
      "::: {.callout-note}",
      sprintf(
        "A variable is only tested if it has at least %1$d observations (`n_obs >= %1$d`) over all the evaluated USMs.", # nolint: line_length_linter
        min_obs
      ),
      ":::",
      ""
    ))
  }
}
```

### Comparison plot

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
```
